soldier: The soldier has the head brownish yellow, the anterior region slightly deeper, labrum brownish yellow, pronotum pale yellowish brown and slightly deeper than the back of the head, mesonotum, metanotum and abdomen pale yellow, femora, tibiae and tarsi pale yellow; the head with a few scattered hairs, the back of the head almost hairless. Head nearly rectangular, the lateral margins broadly arcuate, widest slightly behind the midpoint, the posterolateral angles continuous with the posterior margin in a semicircle, slightly contracted on both sides near the front. Frontal ridges indistinct, in profile the frontal surface forming a slope of about 45 degrees, the head thickest at the middle. Pale eye spots situated behind the antennal sockets on both sides of the head. Mandibles stout: left mandible with four marginal teeth, the first and second close together; right mandible with two, the first triangular, situated slightly before the midpoint, the second obtusely triangular, situated slightly behind the midpoint. Antennae with 12 segments, the third and fourth incompletely divided. The anterior part of the postmentum expanded, the posterior part narrow, club-shaped. Pronotum distinctly narrower than the head, the anterior margin concave-arcuate, the anterolateral angles narrowly rounded and slightly projecting forwards, the lateral margins nearly straight, contracting backwards and curving towards the venter, the posterior margin narrow and nearly straight, the posterolateral angles broadly rounded.
